title: PARDUS SUPG2 SPORT official naming and trim recheck
notes: The official SUPER series page lists SUPG2 SPORT as a second-generation long-distance endurance road bike (第二代长途耐力风格公路车) with 105, EGR and PES configurations. The linked SUPG2 SPORT product page, titled SUPG2 SPORT and showing the 105 build, describes endurance styling with aero elements and 40C tire capacity, and lists an HS-HPT carbon frame and fork with 700×40C maximum tires. Naming and platform evidence only; the 105 build's parts are not applied to the eGR build.
